firstName.description: First name (required if no company name)

lastName.description: Last name (required if no company name)

archive.description: Set to true to archive the contact

remove.description: Set to true to permanently delete the contact

timeEntryId.description: Time entry ID (for get, update, delete)

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable (for create/update)

query.description: Search query to filter contacts by name, email, phone, customer ID, etc.

creditInvoiceId.description: ID of the created credit invoice (for createCredit action)

sepaActive.description: Whether SEPA direct debit is active

billedInvoiceId.description: ID of the invoice created from billing the estimate

period.description: Filter by period: "this_month", "prev_month", "this_quarter", "this_year", "prev_year", or custom range "YYYYMMDD..YYYYMMDD"

state.description: Invoice state (draft, open, paid, late, etc.)

paused.description: Whether the invoice workflow is paused

unlink.description: Set to true to unlink instead of link

bookingId.description: ID of the entity to link/unlink

contactId.description: Contact ID to send the estimate to

recurringInvoiceId.description: Recurring invoice ID (for get, update, delete)

hasDesiredCount.description: Whether to limit the number of invoices generated

desiredCount.description: Number of invoices to generate before deactivating

productId.description: Product ID (auto-fills description, price, tax rate)

ledgerAccountId.description: Ledger account ID (for get, update, delete)
